verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and compliance SaaS that holds sensitive company, tax and mail data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents user-controlled retention periods, deletion requests, or account/data purge. The only nearby items are adjacent: 'Unlimited digital storage', recycling of physical mail, and financial data exports, none of which is a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
